key_findings: MEDIUM is 100% literature-mined (2162/2162). No coverage gap.
GOLDEN is 91.5% unmined — but full-data precision is HIGHER for unmined (86.9%) vs mined (83.7%), so mining won't improve tier.
HIGH has 342 unmined predictions (30.5%) with only 41.2% full-data precision vs 78.4% for mined — this is the key gap.
HIGH unmined are dominated by: corticosteroid_soc_promotion (167), metabolic_hierarchy_diabetes (50), transe_medium_promotion (37), cancer_same_type_mech_rank10 (31)
HIGH CS SOC unmined: 39.5% full-data precision — below HIGH average. Mining could reveal demotion candidates.
HIGH cancer_same_type unmined: 19.4% full-data precision — very low, likely cancer subtypes without expanded GT coverage.
LOW/FILTER are 97-99% unmined — previous h800 found 0% STRONG ROI for these. Confirmed not worth mining.
Literature mining is highly selective: assessed predictions have much higher full-data precision, confirming mining was strategically targeted at actionable predictions.

roi_estimate.HIGH_342_unmined: MEDIUM ROI — 342 predictions, many CS SOC (known high-quality). Mining could identify ~20 NO_EVIDENCE for sub-reason audit. Estimated effort: 2-3 hours mining.
roi_estimate.GOLDEN_464_unmined: LOW ROI — 86.9% full-data precision already high. Mining confirms quality but won't change tiers.
roi_estimate.LOW_6066_unmined: ZERO ROI — h800 established LOW/FILTER mining has 0% STRONG evidence rate.
